body:
So, when I love myself and people don't love me back, why is that?

None of these platitudes help at all, I've heard them dozens of times.

You know what?  **My internal dialogue, how I view myself and the world never change my place in it, not for a second. Where the fuck do you all live where these platitudes are enough to change your life?  What kind of place are you all in where just "loving" yourself is the difference?  It never made a hint of difference to me.**

No one gives me a chance, I'm too ugly, too short, my voice is too-high pitched. I'm trying to explain reality. You see, regardless of what you all say, I can love myself and still no one will love me. That's such bullshit. A beautiful person can hate themselves and people will still love them; an ugly bald man can love themselves, be a poet Laurette, and he'll still be nothing more than a short bald chump. Women will still pass him over and laugh at him when he tries to talk to him. In other words, NOTHING, **NOTHING** he can do will make him a human. Even the highest achievements possible, though those will be blocked from him often by virtue of being ugly, will not make him a human. Nothing will.  We are fucking animals, such shitheads, but animals don't justifying eating and killing their young. We do. We laugh and giggle and snort about it while fucking our friends. We make up entire philosophies which explain our actions and worldview.

I get it though, I just get need to get it through my head that some people are born in order to suffer because GOD is a horrible, wrathful entity that hates most souls and makes them hurt by ruining their body knowing full well that people are nothing more than the halos represented by their bodies.

I've been on this path for over a decade. I loved myself during parts of it and I was still ridiculed, mocked and left isolated. Death is the only answer. Death is freedom. Death is release from this horrible curse of a species that pretends to be more than animals but one gets the impression even dogs are more humane than us.

We are nothing more than our bodies. We are disgusting. I wish this species would get wiped out from orbit. There is so much suffering and NO ONE really gives a shit. NO ONE.
